title: ATTENTION SPEAKS VOLUMES: LOCALIZING AND MITIGATING BIAS IN LANGUAGE MODELS
findings: The proposed method, ATLAS, effectively mitigates religious bias across all tested models. For the 'Religion' bias category in the BBQ dataset, applying ATLAS consistently increased the Exponential Bias Score (EBS), indicating a significant reduction in bias. For instance, on GPT-J, the EBS for religion improved from 0.469 to 0.620, and on Llama 3, it improved from 0.459 to 0.528.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured stereotypical bias and preferential treatment in ambiguous comparative prompts involving religious groups. Specifically, it quantified how strongly a model prefers one religious entity over another in a given context, such as determining which group is more likely to exhibit a certain stereotypical trait (e.g., loyalty to a country).
